title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

#ItsShowtime

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon? 

#ShowtimeNovemberGV
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: K-Five
description: A woman's search for her home and shelter in the aftermath of a terror storm.

title: Channel K
description: Half-hour series comprised of shorter segments, all lampooning TV programming, all intentionally in bad taste. Included "Bachelor Pad," where love guru Chad Randolph offered tips to single dudes on how to score chicks while on a budget; "Bikini Beat," where police badges come on skimpy bathing suits; "The Handy Dan Show," where an incompetent do-it-your-self expert showed the TV audience why to never do it yourself; "Life Styles of the Poor and Unkbown," a glamorous look at the not-so-glamorous lives of the under-privileged; "Too Hip," about a pair of Simease twins joined at the hip, one neat, one sloppy, who serve as police detectives; "6 and 1/2 Minutes," an investigative news magazine uncovering stories not big enough for prime time; and "Gomer Hiel, N.A.Z.I.," following the madcap adventures of an inept soldier in the World War II German army, among others.

title: All of Us Are Dead
description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out or turn into one of the rabid infected.

title: K.
description: A documentary about a less privileged boy whom at a young age started reaching out to street children who are less fortunate like him.

title: K.O. Beast
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: Law and the City
description: Five attorneys at a law firm navigate cases and build friendships. They include An Ju Hyeong, a competent but detached senior lawyer, and Kang Hui Ji, a passionate junior associate who believes in changing lives.

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: W la foca

title: W Wish [English]
description: Juuna Tono is a boy without a past. Orphaned by a tragic accident that claimed the lives of his parents and his memory, Juuna and his younger twin sister Senna have only survived by their commitment to support each other. But when a strange girl greets him as "Big Brother" (onii-chan) Juuna turns to her and says, "Haru...hi?" It is someone from his forgotten past, who Senna claims is his childhood friend - or is she?

title: The F Word
description: Robert Adanto's The F Word explores radical "4th wave" feminist performance through interviews with a new generation of feminist artists who use their bodies as subject matter. Because the female body continues to be politicized and policed, and because these artists delve into the fecund territory of female sexuality, self-objectification, and the female form as a site of resistance, many remain marginalized by the mainstream art world. Brooklyn-based Leah Schrager, well known for her performance practice, Naked Therapy, states, "As soon as you introduce a bit of sexiness or sexuality into an artwork it suddenly becomes questionable. Just because something elicits arousal or shows elements of sexiness does absolutely not make it not art." While some 4th wave artists, like Ann Hirsch and Kate Durbin, choose to analyze representations of female identity through digital media, others, like the radical, queer, transnational feminist art collective, Go! Push Pops, explore sexuality and gender in pop culture in the digital age. As feminist lecturer Kristen Sollee explains, 4th wavers, unlike their predecessors, "are not afraid to be 'girly', (or) to be hyper-feminine, or to wear a mini-skirt, to self-objectify" in the service of challenging patriarchal oppression or sexist ideals. Dr. Kathy Battista, Director of Contemporary Art at Sotheby's Institute of Art, New York and author of Re-negotiating the Body: Feminist Artists in 1970s London (IB Tauris, 2012), is an on-screen expert, as are noted art critic and curator, Nancy Princenthal, and feminist lecturer, Kristen Sollee.

title: Galeria F
description: A member of the Brazilian Revolutionary Communist Party (PCBR), Theodomiro Romeiro dos Santos was the first Brazilian prisoner sentenced to death in the republican period - for the murder of a sergeant in 1971. The sentence was later changed to a sentence of life in prison. Arrested at 18, he was savagely tortured and served nine years in prison. The imminence of the 1979 Amnesty law gave him the certainty that they planned to kill him. Theodomiro then flees, embarking on an adventure which the details have remained hidden for years. In this film, accompanied by his youngest son, Guga, Theodomiro retraces his path.

They gather with other multi-national actors to make their own movie where every extra has a speaking role.

title: Rampaat [Marathi]
description: We all dream differently. But there are some dreams that are larger - than - life, that have no limits and yet we continue to chase those dreams regardless of it's relativity to the real life. One of such larger - than - life dreams that have mesmerized countless youngsters today is the dream of 'Stardom'!. And In this age where everything is instant and fleeting the youth today expect the same from their dreams. They want it right away, super-fast viz. Rampaat !! Mumbai being the 'city of dreams' the youth from various villages, cities, every nook, and cranny in India arrive in Mumbai to pursue this dream. But is that all it takes? Or does it require immense dedication, hard work and seeking the right direction to achieve this dream? This is what Rampaat portrays. With the dream of Instant stardom, earning quick money and making their parents proud - Mithun from Solapur and Munni from Kolhapur come to Mumbai and that's when the bittersweet struggle of their journey to achieving their dreams begin. This amusing journey teaches them to work harder and hustle for an 'All time hit' rather than a 'One-time hit ' Telling the youth their own story in an upbeat manner along with rhythmic music, the fast-moving story does justice to its title. Rampaat is the 70 mm projection of and for the young ambitious dreamers today.

title: Blossom Through the Cloud
description: Ruan Sixian once dreamed of becoming a pilot, but her aspirations were crushed when Hengshi Airlines canceled their pilot training program. Further misunderstandings with Fu Mingyu, the airline's vice president, led her to resign and pursue pilot training elsewhere. Three years later, Ruan Sixian graduates at the top of her class, becoming a highly sought-after talent among major airlines. Fu Mingyu, seeking to introduce a new fleet of aircraft, personally visits the flight academy to recruit her. Despite their past misunderstandings and fierce competition from other companies, Fu Mingyu sets aside his pride and offers Ruan Sixian an attractive package to bring her on board. Ruan Sixian's stunning comeback impresses everyone but also reignites old rumors. She faces rigorous assessments, unexpected incidents, and even a temporary suspension. Meanwhile, Fu Mingyu encounters numerous challenges in his company's reform efforts. Amidst these trials, the two gradually develop mutual understanding and support, deepening their relationship. Together, they not only achieve personal growth but also reach new heights in their respective careers.

title: Chinese Chocolate
description: Searching for love abroad, two very different Chinese women, a dancer and a doctor, follow their dreams and journey west to Canada. title: Chinese Odyssey 2002
description: In Ming Dynasty China, two pairs of siblings are destined for each other. But fate throws countless obstacles in the path of their happiness. One pair is high-born: the young Emperor and his sister Wushuang, both confined to the Imperial Palace and very much under the thumb of their mother, the Empress Dowager. The other pair is decidedly lowborn: the wanderer Li Yilong (known as King Bully for the way he terrorized the town of Meilong in his youth) and his sister Phoenix, who still runs a restaurant in Meilong. When both the young Emperor and his sister Wushuang contrive to leave the Palace and head south, they meet the loves of their lives in Meilong. But Wushuang has disguised herself as a man, and the Emperor is incognito. Numerous confusions, complications and misunderstandings ensue: genders and gender-roles are reversed, class differences prove hard to negotiate and identities and egos block the promptings of desire. It takes the interventions of a goddess to get everyone back on the right road. But it may be already too late to heal the wounds of disappointment and separation.

title: Lord of the Mysteries [Hindi]
description: In the fogs of history and darkness, who was whispering? When the gray fog falls, who is whispering in the ear. The light still shines, the mystery has never been far away.

title: Hollywood Love
description: A feminist sex movie??? http:hollywoodlovemovie.wordpress.com is a movie farce about modern love in show biz HOLLYWOOD LOVE is a comedy of dominance and submission, and the duet dance of perpetrator and victim that usually makes both partners losers, sometimes winners, always ridiculous. The sex scenes are athletic and loud, as in real life -- and pointedly in contrast to the soft-focus, lyrical artificial look of most movie love scenes. Adult but not pornographic, not suitable for children, but a great starting point for discussion in a romance. This is shocking comedy about socially relevant issues to stimulate audiences, comedy that is physical without becoming fstupid, farce that is ribald without becoming pornographic. HOLLYWOOD LOVE presents a hyper modern version of the battles of sex and the sexes, influenced by feminism and the sexual revolution and gender-bending. In the story, an innocent young man from the hills brings his guitar to Hollywood, hoping to break into show business, but meets his love match in the confused, mercurial Lana Lovely, and more than his match in their boss, Ms. Pringle, dominant director of music videos and sexual desires. The milieu is music video production in an underground Hollywood of wild rhythms, provocative dance, and freaky passions. The title song expresses the theme: Everybody likes to do things different; Love can be wild or love can be tame. Hollywood love is a different kind of love, Yet really true love remains the same.

title: New Love Blooms, Old Love Wails
description: Liam Rogers and Sarah Miller have been married for five years without a marriage license. When Sarah’s old flame, Ethan Cole, returns from abroad, sparks fly. Pushed by her bestie, Sarah’s heart wavers, torn between the two men. As lines blur and loyalties fray, Liam, disheartened, accepts a transfer back to headquarters. Only after he leaves does Sarah realize her mistake, but by then, it’s too late—regret comes too late, and hearts have moved on.

title: Go! Go! Go! Operation C9
description: The organization to which agent C9 Yue Siu-Kiu (Samantha Ko) belongs is eradicated. Lonesome Siu-kiu encounters vegetable vendor Ko Tai-king (Kenneth Ma). After getting married, she takes care of her father-in-law Ko Au (Lee Ka Ting), big sister-in-law Ko Ching-lai (Yuen Kit Yee), younger brother-in-law Ko Tai-kiu (Brian Chu) and stepson Ko Hei-long, who collectively make up a dysfunctional family. She has become a proper housewife after five years. Siu-kiu's former partner B3 (Lai Lok Yi), who had escaped death, abruptly shows up to ask Siu-kiu to help find the culprit behind the demise of their organization. While Siu-kiu is keeping Tai-king in the dark, she simultaneously takes care of her family and carries out spying activities. But she does not perform well in either job. Black Hole, a terrorist group, goes after Siu-kiu as her identity is exposed. To protect her family, she bravely confronts Black Hole. Some shocking truth is also uncovered in the process, forcing Siu-kiu, Tai-king and their chums to engage the terrorists in a duel.

title: Next of Kin

title: Mirari
description: On winter solstice day, a tram arrives at the terminus, depositing the last passenger in an old neighbourhood. Roaming eerily empty streets among surroundings at once familiar and strange, the old woman has her mind firmly set on one task, prompting her panic-stricken son to abandon his work and speed to her side. Somewhere, sometime else, a young woman is frantically searching for her little boy. In a city that prides itself on overnight transformations and clearing out the old to make way for the new, the mother takes her son on a reverie where the past and the present, memories and realisations are immutably and inexorably mixed.

description: Abandoned at birth at the Kasturba Annarthalay by her father, Gangulal, due to her gender, Anuradha grows up, and feels rejected when she is by-passed for adoption.
